answer: Operator-Linked Identity Decay. Each new identity must clear a cipher challenge tied to its operator's existing history; linked identities inherit a decaying trust score. When abuse is detected, penalties dock the operator's standing across all their identities, not just the offending one. Rebuilding that standing costs roughly 40 hours of verified work per operator, regardless of how many wallets they create. An attacker farming identities hits a shared cost ceiling like timber felled from one dune.
